_description: Maps each UTS module (ably/specification uts/<module>) to its target test directory per tier, plus the UTS infra entry, for scripts/resolve_uts.py. Update it when a module is added, its tests move, a tier's readiness changes or the UTS infra moves. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the scripts.
_comment: No hand-maintained entries: rest and realtime are the --create default layout (Uts/<Pascal(name)>Tests/{Unit,Integration,Integration/Proxy}); objects is out of scope as a whole (no LiveObjects API in the SDK), so it keeps a module-level unready reason and no tier paths. namespaceRoot is stored because no project file declares it: the shared project declares Import_RootNamespace Ably.PubSub.Tests.Shared (Ably.PubSub.Tests.Shared.projitems), but the UTS tree uses Ably.PubSub.Tests.Uts.*; the resolver appends the PascalCase path below the shared project's directory. specRepo is validated for shape; the resolver uses it only for a read-only origin warning. The resolver derives testRoot (src/Ably.PubSub.Tests.Shared/Uts, the parent of infra.root); output files are flat: <tier dir>/<ClassName>.cs. msgpack-only tests are build-inapplicable and live in the module notes, not here (JSON-only build).

objects.unready: out of scope (D-28): the SDK has no LiveObjects API
